verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Requesty's 'auto caching', which caches long system prompts and repeated content on providers that support prompt caching. That is provider-side prompt-prefix caching, a related but different capability. Nothing shows Requesty storing and serving full responses at the gateway, so repeated requests still go to the provider and there is no documented gateway response cache.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests
